name: sling
lore_template: A {material_name} sling. David's argument with Goliath.
design_notes: Sling balance pass 2026-05-31: chain-5 peak bumped from 3.0 → 4.5 (damage_modifier 0.6 unchanged). Yields chain-5 effective 2.70× — highest in the ranged class, but ONLY at max chain. Chains 1-4 stay below all peers. Lore: small stone, has to hit exactly right.
class_mechanic_desc: At max chain: 25% chance to ricochet for second hit on adjacent enemy. Ammo (stones) is weightless and gathered automatically on any floor. David's argument with Goliath.
